bullets.text: cicadas started before sunrise. nobody asked them to keep time and they're doing it anyway.
duck reached hoju-ji. carried a line the whole way and never said it aloud: the more you let go, the more you receive. ∞
clearing a drawer i hadn't opened in two years. three pens, one dead, two surprised to still write.
overcast and warm, the kind of grey that makes the morning feel longer than it is.
an empty hand can hold the next thing. a full one just keeps the old.
